Checkout's gRPC dials to payment on 9999 time out, so every Charge/PlaceOrder call fails and the error ratio sits near 34%. Rolling back to revision 1 should restore service.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (50%): Slow product-catalog path: GetProduct/ListProducts spans show about 5-5.7s of self time plus 2s per astronomy-db call. Possible causes include connection-pool wait, lock waits, or per-request work. Pod lpgbw had repeated container start events at 15:27 that may be a restart. Not yet confirmed.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (60%): product-catalog is slow in GetProduct and ListProducts: about 5s of self time not covered by child spans, on top of 1-2s astronomy-db calls. This is the earliest point in the latency chain, and it propagates to recommendation, frontend and frontend-proxy. The cause inside product-catalog (connection pool wait, serialization, or unrecorded work) is not yet isolated.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (45%): Latency is added inside product-catalog itself: GetProduct and ListProducts show about 5s self time, more than the about 2s astronomy-db client time. This is consistent with connection-pool wait, lock wait or CPU contention in the app. No change explains the onset.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (70%): The PostgreSQL dependency (astronomy-db) became slow for all callers from about 15:49Z, with queries taking about 2-4.7s instead of about 2ms. Product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts then take seconds, and checkout, recommendation, frontend and frontend-proxy inherit the latency. The likely locus is the database (locks, pool, CPU or I/O), since no product-catalog or astronomy-db change occurred.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (60%): product-catalog is slow per request, with about 5s of unexplained self time per GetProduct plus slow astronomy-db queries (about 2s each). root cause candidate: product-catalog (50%): Requests spend most of their time in product-catalog itself (self time about 5.4s of 7.3s GetProduct) and in its astronomy-db client calls (about 2s each, several per request). The cause is inside product-catalog or its DB connection path, such as pool exhaustion, a blocking or serialized query pattern, or a silent wait. Not confirmed.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (50%): Under a sudden ~10x increase in request volume from about 15:38, product-catalog spends most of each request in its own code (self time), likely from resource saturation or connection/worker pool wait. The mechanism is not yet confirmed.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (60%): Requests to product-catalog are slow (GetProduct, ListProducts p95 about 9s). The fault is in product-catalog or in its database path; the exact location is not yet determined.

root cause candidate: product-catalog (60%): Its PostgreSQL calls to astronomy-db are slow (queueing or stalling), so every product-catalog server span is slow, which propagates to checkout, recommendation and frontend-proxy. root cause candidate: product-catalog (60%): Its PostgreSQL call path is slow: astronomy-db calls take about 1.9s each versus about 1ms baseline, and GetProduct/ListProducts carry about 5s of self time.
